Name: Less Creepy Marnie Sprite
Author: EveriasArt
Description:
[size=4]
[color=#b6d7a8]I don't know about you but Marnie's smile disturbs me so I edited her sprite to remove it. This is a mod that I made for myself that others can use if they want as well! [/color][/size][color=#b6d7a8]
[/color]
[size=4]If you're interested, check out my other mods: [/size][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1453?]Matching Maru Sprite[/url] & [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1884]Espeon Cat[/url][/size]

[center][i][size=4]* [/size][size=3]Also if you have any suggestions for this mod feel free to let me know! Feedback is always welcome[/size][size=4] *[/size][/i][/center]
[b]

[color=#a4c2f4][size=3]To Install:
[/size][/color][/b][size=3][color=#a4c2f4]------------

1. Download the file

2. Go to your Stardew Valley folder > Contents > Characters 

3. Find [b]Marnie.xnb[/b] and rename to [b]Marnie.xnb.bck[/b] (Doing this backs up the original file and keeps it inactive in it's folder so you never lose it)

4. Unzip the downloaded file

5. Place the new [b]Marnie.xnb[/b] in the characters folder (Make sure to leave [b]Marnie.xnb.bck[/b] in the same folder)

6. Yay!! You're done! Now you can play the game and be free from Marnie's horrifying face
[/color]

[color=#b4a7d6][b]To Uninstall:[/b]
---------------

1. Go to your Stardew Valley folder > Contents > Characters

2. Find [b]Marnie.xnb[/b] and remove it (put it in another folder, delete it, eat it, whatever you want)

3. Rename [b]Marnie.xnb.bck[/b] back to [b]Marnie.xnb[/b]

4. That's all! Launch the game[/color][/size][color=#9fc5e8]
[/color]

[size=2][u]Note[/u]: When you rename the files it will pop up a thing saying something like "this file could become unusable", you can click yes and the files will be fine don't worry
[/size]

[color=#b6b6b6][size=1][center]~If you would like to upload this mod to another site please let me know and link me in the description, thank you![/center][/size][/color]
